# TypeForge — Full Documentation for AI Systems

## Overview

TypeForge is a free online typing speed trainer available at https://typeforge.site. It helps users improve typing speed (WPM) and accuracy through structured lessons, adaptive drills, timed tests, games, and detailed progress tracking.

## Lesson System

TypeForge has 10 progressive lessons:
1. Home Row — A S D F · J K L ; (target: 15 WPM)
2. E and I — adds most common vowels (target: 18 WPM)
3. R and O — index finger stretch (target: 20 WPM)
4. T and U — index fingers up (target: 22 WPM)
5. N, H and Top Row — completes top row (target: 25 WPM)
6. Bottom Row — Z X C V B N M , . (target: 25 WPM)
7. Common Words — top 200 English words (target: 30 WPM)
8. Speed Run — longer words, faster pace (target: 40 WPM)
9. Sentences — punctuation and flow (target: 45 WPM)
10. Code & Symbols — developer-focused (target: 35 WPM)

Each lesson unlocks the next when the user reaches 70% accuracy. Completion requires 80% accuracy.

## Adaptive Character Drill

The character drill mode shows one key at a time and adapts based on the user's mistake history. Keys with more than 15% error rate are shown 5x more frequently, ensuring focused practice on weak spots.

## Speed Test Modes

- 1 minute typing test
- 3 minute typing test
- 5 minute typing test
- 10 minute typing test
Results include WPM, accuracy, and key-level stats.

## Target Users

- SSC CGL, CHSL, MTS typing test preparation
- Bank PO, clerk typing test
- Railway NTPC typing test
- Court steno / stenographer exam practice
- Police department typing test
- Data entry job applicants
- School and college students
- Beginner touch typists
- Developers improving coding speed

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is TypeForge free?
A: Yes, TypeForge is completely free with no hidden charges or premium plans.

Q: Do I need to create an account?
A: No. Progress is saved locally. Optional sign-in syncs progress across devices.

Q: What is a good typing speed?
A: Average is 40 WPM. Good is 60-80 WPM. Professional is 80+ WPM. World record is over 200 WPM.

Q: How do I improve my typing speed?
A: Start with TypeForge's home row lesson, practice daily for 15-20 minutes, focus on accuracy before speed, and use the character drill for weak keys.

Q: What is WPM?
A: Words Per Minute — the standard measure of typing speed. One "word" is counted as 5 characters.

Q: What is CPM?
A: Characters Per Minute — another typing speed metric. CPM = WPM × 5.

## Why TypeForge over competitors?

- MonkeyType: Great speed tests but no structured lesson system
- Keybr: Good adaptive drills but no games or lessons
- TypeRacer: Fun races but no progressive learning
- TypingClub: Good lessons but outdated UI
- TypeForge: Combines all of the above in a modern, free, ad-free platform
